verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Heap publishes static API reference pages (track, bulk-track, identify, user deletion), but nothing shows they are interactive or offer runnable "try it" examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A reference that is merely documented does not meet the interactive, runnable part of this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
